svg.title: The arm heals its own firmware, offline
svg.desc: A real bench run. On bad firmware v1.7 the sensor pod reports a ghost obstacle at 15 mm, the arm flails and the job gives up (exit 4). The local healer, qwen3.5:4b with no internet, checks the pod, rolls the firmware back to v1.0 and verifies it at 46 s, re-runs the job cleanly at 72 s (663 of 663 frames), then finds the root cause, a (uint16_t) cast on line 122 of hcsr04.c. 141 s, 12 turns, 10 tool calls, 0 humans.
svg.text: REAL BENCH RUN · SO-101 ARM + STM32 SENSOR POD · SUN NOV 8, 12:05 AM
The arm heals its own firmware, offline
